products.name: Fresh Kolar Nati Tomatoes
products.description: Freshly harvested country tomatoes (Naati) plucked this morning. Tart, juicy, full of natural aroma without synthetic ripeners.

products.name: Doddabyalakere Palak & Methi Bunch
products.description: Crisp green farm-fresh bundle harvested at dawn with organic compost methods. Perfect for Dal Palak and Methi Theplas.

products.name: Yelakki Banana Bunch (Kadur Native)
products.description: Karnataka favorite Yelakki bananas tree-ripened with hay stacks, zero carbide or chemicals. Sweet, aromatic, and compact.

products.name: Cold Pressed Wood-Ghani Coconut Oil
products.description: Extracted in traditional wooden cold press (Mara Gana) using sun-dried copra from Tiptur orchards. Unrefined, unbleached pure aroma.

products.name: Single-Origin Byadgi Whole Chillies
products.description: Authentic Byadgi chillies with deep crimson color and mild smokey warmth. Hand-sorted and sun-cured without synthetic red powders.

products.name: Channapatna Wooden Stacking Toy & Rocker
products.description: Turned on traditional hand lathes using ivory-wood (Aale Mara) and polished with non-toxic natural lac and vegetable dyes.

products.name: Handcrafted Clay Curd Pot & Water Jug
products.description: Kiln-fired by 3rd generation potters using Arkavathi riverbed red clay. Naturally alkalizes water and gives thick sweet curd setting.

products.name: Devaraja Market Pure Ghee Mysore Pak
products.description: Crafted following the historic royal Wadiyar recipe with hand-roasted gram flour, simmered in golden desi butter ghee. Melts effortlessly on tongue.

products.name: Farm-Fresh Country Brown Eggs (Free Range)
products.description: Laid by free-grazing native Aseel breed hens fed on sorghum, greens, and grains. Deep orange yolks rich in omega-3.

products.name: Hand-Pounded Organic Sona Masuri Raw Rice
products.description: Grown along the Tungabhadra river plains and aged for 12 months. Single-polish retains wholesome nutrient bran layer.

products.name: Ilkal Handloom Cotton Stole / Scarf
products.description: Handwoven by master weavers in Bagalkot district featuring the distinctive Tope Teni border and natural dyed combed cotton.

products.name: Cold Infused Pure Forest Honey (Nilgiri Flora)
products.description: Harvested sustainably by indigenous honey hunters from wild hives in Western Ghats foothills. Unpasteurized and full of natural pollen.
